card.name: Words introducing warnings or instructions
card.fires_on: Words that come right before the content of a warning, label statement, or instruction to patients, such as "warned", "instruct", "alert consumers not", or "stating that". It is found in label and safety-requirement text.

modes.label: Warning or instruct verbs
modes.description: The verb or noun naming the act of warning or instructing, right before what is to be told.
modes.example: They should also be<< warned>> about the concomitant use of alcohol

modes.label: Linking word before the stated content
modes.description: A small word such as that, not, the or such after a verb of labeling, alerting, or emphasizing.
modes.example: A label must be printed on the trampoline box stating<< that>> trampolines over 20

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like instructions, warnings, and tell/notify in the next position.
card.plain: It lights up where a label or guide is about to tell the reader what to be warned about or told to do.
